name: Touching The Dead
overview: Scripture teaches that touching a dead body results in ceremonial uncleanness for seven days, emphasizing the holiness required in approaching death and its consequences (Numbers 19:11). While physical impurity is addressed, God's mercy surpasses human sinfulness, as He pardons iniquity and delights in mercy rather than retaining anger (Micah 7:18). Additionally, the power of the tongue to defile the whole person illustrates how spiritual uncleanness can arise internally, reminding believers that true purity involves both outward and inward holiness (James 3:6).
